Builds gossip transaction bytes and tracks appended CRDS values.

# Purpose
`fd_gossip_txbuild.c` builds a serialized gossip transmit message in memory. It defines packed wire-format layouts for a CRDS value header and for the outer gossip message, then provides functions to initialize the message, check whether more CRDS data can fit, and append CRDS entries into the message buffer. The code writes the message header fields, copies the identity public key, tracks the total byte length, and updates the CRDS count as entries are added.

The file also maintains an index of appended CRDS items in `txbuild->crds`, with each entry storing the CRDS tag, byte offset, and size inside the serialized buffer. The [`fd_gossip_txbuild_append`](<#fd_gossip_txbuild_append>) function validates input sizes with `FD_TEST`, copies the CRDS payload into the output buffer, and records metadata needed to reference each appended value later. This file is part of the gossip transmit build path and exposes helper functions used to construct a complete outbound gossip message.
